data.body:
[P1] Allow elapsed deadlines to complete during an active invocation

This guard withholds the checkpoint update as well as the clock jump. The SDK cannot suspend while a step is `EXECUTING`, so a one-second wait raced against a slow step cannot win even after its deadline passes. If the step depends on work performed after the wait, the run deadlocks. Retries have the same problem. Preserve a timer path that publishes `SUCCEEDED`/`READY` when deadlines naturally expire during an active invocation, restricting only clock jumps and reinvocation to idle periods. Add regression coverage for waits and retries alongside an executing step.
